MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 299, March 06, 1971 ]
CREATING THE PRESIDENTIAL COOPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL
WHEREAS, the development of cooperatives is a means for redistributing income and wealth in the country;
WHEREAS, the operation of cooperatives is a way of making available essential services to both producers
and consumers;
WHEREAS, social and economic strength can be gained and efficiency attained if people with common
objectives bind themselves into cooperatives;
WHEREAS, it is avowed policy of the administration to encourage the organization of cooperatives and assist
their growth;
WHEREAS, there is a pressing need for a comprehensive and integrated program of cooperative
developments; and
WHEREAS, there are at present no less than fourteen (14) government agencies charged with the promotion,
organization and development of cooperatives, thereby bringing out the need for an administrative machinery
to unify all efforts towards these ends;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue
of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby create a Presidential Cooperative Development Council.
The Council shall have the following functions:
1. To review past efforts and progress attained in cooperative development;
2. To evolve a comprehensive and integrated cooperative program;
3. To determine the organizational and financial requirements of such a program;
4. To coordinate the activities of all government and private agencies involved in cooperative development;
5. To review and recommend budgetary and financial requests by government agencies on expenditures for
cooperative development;
6. To submit reports on the status and accomplishments of the cooperative development program.
The Council shall be composed of the following:

Dr. Orlando J. Sacay
2.

Vice-Chairman
3.
The Director, Cooperative Administrative Office

19.

20.

22.

23.
President, Rural Reconstruction Movement
The Council may create such committees as may be necessary to carry out its functions. The Cooperatives
Administration Office shall provide the Secretariat for the Council. The Council is further authorized to call
on any department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of government including government-owned or
controlled corporations for technical-assistance, facilities and equipment as may be needed in the discharge of
This Executive Order repeals Executive Order No. 242 dated June 29, 1970, creating the Cooperative
Coordinating Committee.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
